STR_DOWNGRADE:
Make sure तुम्ही have बॅकअप चा stock sFlash dump आणि SYSCON.

 स्लॉट switching आहे used for FW revert (downgrade).
 Revert can fix "loadbios" त्रुटी, if बॅकअप स्लॉट आहे not corrupted.

 सुरू करा with most relevant pattern, if it doesn't help try others.
 वापरा UART ला track changes in "release_branches/release_xx" line.

 After finding right switch pattern पॅच syscon,
 otherwise तुम्ही'll get "checkUpdVersion" त्रुटी.

STR_INFO_LEG_PATCH:
This method आहे only suitable for working consoles!
 Because it requires updating via PS4 safe menu

 1) वाचा first dump (if तुम्ही've not done it already)
 2) Update  console ONCE (ला obtain second switch pattern)
 3) वाचा second dump (both slots have equal FW)

 Now तुम्ही can पॅच first dump with डेटा पासून second one
 You can drag&drop 2 dumps on wee-साधने shortcut ला speed up
STR_INFO_NVS:
Swaps corrupted ब्लॉक बॅकअपसह डेटा (not suitable for 10xx/11xx)
 इशारा - UART आणि other flags may be overwritten.
 If तुम्ही need ला set some flags do it after NVS recovery!
STR_INFO_PART_A_R:
Compares every byte चा (SFlash/Syscon) partition with valid फाइल
 आणि shows percentage चा similarity.
 Most equal फाइल will be at top चा  list.
 Keep in mind that Southbridge FW consists चा emc + eap
STR_INFO_REGENERATE:
This tool regenerates NVS areas चा dump with help चा donor dump
 Can fix: Reset loop / नाही power / 3 beeps / some other
 it आहे recommended ला use dumps with equal Board ID आणि
 donor dump should have higher or same FW
STR_INFO_RL78FLASH:
In order ला write नवीन blank syscon chip (Renesas RL78G10)
 तुम्ही need USB ला TTL adapter, wires आणि some diodes.

 2xxx 7xxx (Slim/Pro) R5F10*LL*FB 64-pin LFQFP (10×10mm, 0.5mm)
 R5F100LLAFB, R5F100LLDFB, R5F101LLAFB, R5F101LLDFB

 1xxx (Phat) R5F10*PL*FB 100-pin LFQFP (14×14mm, 0.5mm)
 R5F100PLAFB, R5F100PLDFB, R5F101PLAFB, R5F101PLDFB

 Wiring diagram can be सापडले in assets/hw/l78flash फोल्डर
STR_INFO_SB_PATCH:
Will be useful in case चा:

Syscon Flasher allows तुम्ही ला r/w मूळ PS4 syscon chip (RL78/G13)
 Flasher supports only A0x-COLx syscon models
 Currently hardware part आहे based on Teensy boards (2.0++/4.0/4.1)
 Look at </assets/hw/syscon_flasher> for diagrams आणि Teensy's FW
 More माहिती here:
STR_INFO_SC_BOOTMODES:
Boot मोड नोंदी आहेत encrypted, so we can't detect its purpose
 You should try each चा them by yourself ला determine what आहे it for
 These नोंदी serve ला enable/disable FSM (Factory Service मोड)
 Keep in mind: some नोंदी may have duplicates (marked with color)
STR_INFO_SC_GLITCH:
DarkNESmonk चा Syscon रीडर (Arduino Nano V3 CH340)
अधिक माहितीसाठी </assets/hw/syscon_reader> फोल्डर पहा
STR_INFO_SC_MPATCH:
Every नोंद has 16 बाइट length. First byte आहे always "A5"
 The second byte आहे नोंद "प्रकार" usually in range [0x00-0x30]
 Firmware update takes 4 नोंदी with types %s
 To cancel last fw update we need ला स्वच्छ करा these 4 नोंदी (fill 0xFF)
 If there आहेत %s,%s types after %s पॅच आहे impossible
 बॅकअप स्लॉट आहे already overwritten, तुम्ही'll got checkUpdVersion त्रुटी
STR_INFO_SC_REBUILDER:
This util will help तुम्ही ला create custom version चा Syscon.
 Can fix: SU-39176-6, CE-40947-4, Corrupt Syscon, GET_HDMI_STATE,
 Wake Invalid त्रुटी, PSN Activation, leave FSM आणि some other.
 You can adjust each प्रकार चा नोंदी in expert मोड.
 Entries आहेत sorted पासून सध्याचा ला past.
 * To select previous FW तुम्ही need ला इनपुट "2" or more.
 * Minimal setup consists चा 3 types (00-03 + 04-07 + 08-0B)
STR_INFO_SPIWAY:

STR_OVERCLOCKING:
धोकादायक कार्यवाही!

 Most GDDR5 runs at 6000-8000 MHz. GDDR5 आहे quad pumped [x4]
 GDDR5 at 8000 MHz technically runs at 2000 MHz
 If तुम्ही have problems, decrease frequency ला 1000 MHz

 Effective GDDR5 clock आहे 1350 MHz
 The frequency आहे निवडलेले experimentally
 - Too high value can lead ला LOADBIOS -8 or DCT [*] त्रुटी
 - Too low value leads ला AMDINIT त्रुटी
